title: Fix lazyPlanTick starvation: batch-check plan existence, widen candidate window

finding_explained.symptom: Command Hub Autopilot Runs page showed 30 new findings, none processed for hours
finding_explained.root_cause: lazyPlanTick() fetched only 12 candidates ordered by impact_score.desc and checked plan-existence one row at a time; a permanent backlog of 25+ already-planned operator_onramp findings (stuck at status=new pending human review) occupied every slot of that window on every tick, so genuinely-unplanned lower-impact dev_autopilot findings were never reached

mutation_verified.method: reverted the batch filter to a no-op in a backup-and-restore pass, re-ran the new suite
mutation_verified.result: 2/5 tests correctly failed for the right reason, restored byte-identical to the fix

supabase_reads_from_this_session: multiple read-only queries against autopilot_recommendations, dev_autopilot_plan_versions, self_healing_log, dev_autopilot_worker_queue, dev_autopilot_config -- no mutation beyond self-allocating this VTID
live_verification: not performed -- this session cannot place a live request against a deployed gateway. The next real signal is the 4 findings named in acceptance.md gaining dev_autopilot_plan_versions rows on the next staging deploy's tick.
